page.content:
Inside-out crab (or surimi), avocado, and cucumber roll — a global gateway.

How California roll connects

  • Item: Maki — The California roll is an inside-out maki adapted in the United States.
  • Item: Nori — The California roll hides nori inside the rice.

What is California roll?

The California roll, attributed to Japanese chefs working in Los Angeles, hid nori inside and used avocado when fatty tuna was scarce — sushi adapted for a new coast.

Key threads lead to Maki and Nori.
